Education

I am currently completing my Bachelor of Environmental Science, minoring in Geospatial Analysis at the University of the Sunshine Coast. I have taken extra time and effort to tailor my studies towards data analysis and have a passion for using R to solve ecological problems. My minor in geospatial analysis has taught me skills in geographical information systems (GIS) , remote sensing, field surveying, and drone mapping techniques which I am hoping to expand upon and apply to industry in the near future.

I have undertaken several self-led extra-curricular projects opportunities through university that have led to me developing additional skills in statistical programming, data analysis and technical report writing, including developing a program to automate pre-processing for Kaleidoscope acoustic data, programmatically generating reports for environmental consultants based on machine learning animal behaviour data-sets and investigating modelling techniques to provide a technical report on the suitability of a modelling framework for marine ecosystem management. These projects can be found on my portfolio page or my Github
